ud mattresses, you select your delivery date during checkout. Once dispatched, BJS Home Delivery will email you with a tracking link and a 3-hour delivery window for that pre-selected date. They will also call you when they are on the way.

For bedding accessories, delivery usually happens between 8am and 6pm, Monday-Friday. On the day of delivery, you will receive an email or SMS with a 1-hour delivery window.

If you need more specific information, please let me know.
